datasets.title: Biobank of Karolinska Endarterectomy (BiKE)
datasets.summary: A biobank collection of carotid plaque samples taken from patients undergoing endarterectomy operations.
datasets.overall_design: Samples from carotid plaques and peripheral blood mononuclear cells in a setup with clinical registry data collection. See PMID 22371308 for further details.
datasets.study_design: 颈动脉狭窄患者颈动脉斑块与外周血单个核细胞，转录组芯片分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用颈动脉内膜切除术患者的颈动脉斑块和PBMC样本

evidence.relevant: 样本为颈动脉狭窄患者手术切除的颈动脉斑块组织及配对PBMC，直接研究颈动脉狭窄的核心病理
evidence.sequencing_type: CEL文件经RMA归一化，Affymetrix表达谱芯片，总RNA样本，检测mRNA，无单细胞或特殊富集证据，典型mRNA microarray。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本级临床字段仅含缺血事件和时间，无生存时间/状态字段，无法做患者生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较为斑块vs PBMC，无药物干预或治疗对照臂
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 只有颈动脉斑块和PBMC，两者均来自疾病患者，缺少独立健康对照
evidence.correlation: mRNA microarray表达芯片（CEL/RMA），颈动脉斑块样本126例且配对PBMC共97例，全部来自颈动脉狭窄患者内膜剥脱术，独立患者≥127，远超>15要求。
evidence.sample_source: GSM 明确两批样本：126 例颈动脉斑块（carotid plaque）直接冻存，属实体组织；97 例外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）直接冻存，未分选具体细胞类型，属血液组分。均未经体外培养或分选。

datasets.summary: This SuperSeries is composed of the SubSeries listed below.
datasets.study_design: 人类颈动脉/冠状动脉斑块、PBMC及小鼠模型单细胞RNA-seq/CITE-seq，分析免疫检查点与降脂干预
datasets.relevance_reason: 含颈动脉斑块单细胞转录组与CITE-seq数据

evidence.relevant: 样本含颈动脉内膜剥脱术患者的颈动脉斑块，研究动脉粥样硬化免疫机制，属颈动脉狭窄直接病因/组织。
evidence.sequencing_type: 单细胞样本(41个)含polyA RNA+10x平台=scRNA-seq；4h/24h样本有配对的ADT蛋白库(molecule=protein)与RNA单细胞库，构成CITE-seq；2个小鼠斑块样本library_source=transcriptomic且polyA RNA=mRNA-seq。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本元数据无任何生存时间或状态字段，无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 存在明确的基线(baseline)与随访(followup)配对设计及降脂治疗(lipid lowering)干预组，构成治疗前后核心比较轴。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 斑块样本均来自患者，无正常动脉组织对照；PBMC非组织匹配健康对照
evidence.correlation: scRNA-seq平台，但颈动脉内膜切除术患者样本仅12例（CEA_scRNAseq 1-12），不满足目标疾病临床样本>15的要求
evidence.sample_source: PBMC体外刺激→primary_cell; 颈动脉斑块分选CD45+免疫细胞→primary_cell; 全血样本→blood; 冠状动脉和小鼠斑块无分选证据→tissue。
evidence.pre_post_treatment: GSM treatment字段含baseline与followup标签，并有lipid lowering治疗，指示降脂药物干预前后纵向采样
evidence.response: GSM仅有治疗类型分配（如immune checkpoint inhibitors），无应答/疗效分组标签，不满足条件②。
evidence.treatment_type: [audit2-reflect改判] 原值为含中文解释的散文，非枚举字段合法token，格式污染，必须改判。

datasets.title: Cytokines in the ApoE-/- mice atherosclerotic plaque
datasets.summary: To identify the dynamic changes of cytokines in the ApoE-/- mice atherosclerotic plaque, heart, and serum upon β-adrenergic stimulation (isoproterenol, 5 mg/kg body weight) at 0.5hrs, 1hrs, 3hrs and 24hrs using mouse cytokine antibody arrays.
datasets.overall_design: 45 samples. Male ApoE knockout mice (8 weeks of age, C57BL/6J background) fed a high fat diet containing 40 kcal% fat and 1.25% cholesterol (D12108C, Reaserch Diets, USA) for 2 weeks. Carotid collar placement was performed 2 weeks later to induce carotid artery plaque. After carotid collar placement and high-fat feeding for 3 months, mice were subcutaneously injected with a single dose of ISO (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO, USA; 5 mg/kg body weight, as determined effective by dose-response preliminary experiments) or saline (10 mL/kg body weight).There are 9 groups: vehicle group, mice were subcutaneous injected with a single dose of saline (10 ml/kg body weight), ISO groups, mice were subcutaneous injected with a single dose of isoproterenol (5 mg/kg body weight) after 0.5hrs, 1hrs, 3hrs and 24hrs (vessel, heart and plasma groups by different pionts)
datasets.study_design: ApoE-/-小鼠动脉粥样硬化模型，蛋白阵列检测心脏、血管斑块和血清中细胞因子在ISO刺激后的动态变化
datasets.relevance_reason: 采用ApoE-/-小鼠颈动脉圈诱导的动脉粥样硬化模型，模拟颈动脉狭窄

evidence.sequencing_type: Protein profiling by protein array; 抗体芯片检测组织/血清中细胞因子蛋白丰度，无测序，归蛋白质组学技术。
